880-8338-8345.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-8338-8345.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the land enters the battlefield, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2511-3661-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Shield Sphere is starting in your graveyard.
2511-3661-5006-8170.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Shield Sphere spell. Then, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Shield Sphere, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat.

2317-4826-5147-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat.

2023-4518-4927-6723.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4476-5900-8160.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
4476-5900-8160.notes: Alternate adding {G} and {U} each time. Start by adding the opposite of whatever mana you provide for the {G/U} in the cost.

uses.n: Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements

6867-6869-7117.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang, Airbending Master.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0} due to Aang, Master of Elements.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang, Airbending Master enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
When Appa leaves the battlefield, Aang, Airbending Master triggers, causing you to get an experience counter.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3668-4284.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3668-4284.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Flesh Duplicate and Clone each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Flesh Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Clone trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3668-4284.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1849-3755-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1849-3755-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1849-3755-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

3967-4302-4875.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3967-4302-4875.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Conspiracy, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1069-3228-5434-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-3228-5434-5499.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Soldier.
Activate the Soldier by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

632-3621-4460-4659-5129.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-3621-4460-4659-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

4682-5140-6441-6753.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
4682-5140-6441-6753.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Exalted Sunborn and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
4682-5140-6441-6753.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

2366-4875-5231-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4875-5231-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

826-1636-2034-6935.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing Otherworldly Escort to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
When Otherworldly Escort enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2919-3197-6823.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3197-6823.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is a creature without summoning sickness

478-539-3151--111.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Elves.
478-539-3151--111.description:
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Elvish Archdruid.
Repeat.

2043-4050-5446-6441.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariots enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger, creating eight 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar six times by sacrificing six creature tokens, adding {6}.
Repeat.
2043-4050-5446-6441.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other artifact(s) with Urza's ability.

1150-2018-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Melira's Keepers.
When Melira's Keepers dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Melira's Keepers from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Melira's Keepers' ability.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

880-2653-5671.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Nissa and The Necrobloom trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

225-1170-1770-2733-5954.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1170-1770-2733-5954.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 5 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

225-1170-2397-3389-5954.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1170-2397-3389-5954.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 5 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

372-3563-5913.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Pinnacle Monk exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate.
372-3563-5913.description:
Cast Flicker of Fate by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Pinnacle Monk and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Pinnacle Monk trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Flicker of Fate from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Pinnacle Monk and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1018-2103-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Capture of Jingzhou and Skullwinder each turn.
1018-2103-6122.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Skullwinder by paying its mana cost.
When Skullwinder enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Skullwinder from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

280-1741-5900.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional mana-producing land that can tap to produce at least {U}.
280-1741-5900.description:
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Activate another mana producing land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Golgari Rot Farm and another mana-producing land.
Repeat.

1314-2608-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}, {W} and/or {U}.
1314-2608-4050.description:
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it from the command zone onto the battlefield.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {G}, {W} or {U}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Derevi, adding {G}, {W} or {U}.
Choose not to return Derevi from your graveyard to the command zone.
When Derevi dies, Brenard triggers, exiling Derevi from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is a 1/1 Food Golem artifact creature token.
Choose to return Dervi from exile to the command zone.
When the Derevi token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {G}, {W} or {U}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Derevi token, adding {G}, {W} or {U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

1993-2725-4543.notablePrerequisites:
You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
Tideforce Elemental and Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life do not have summoning sickness.
You control nine or less lands.
1993-2725-4543.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Tideforce Elemental by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Budoka Gardener.
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping it.
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting the land from your hand to the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tideforce Elemental triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

353-1812-2034.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
353-1812-2034.notablePrerequisites: Your storm count is equal to or higher than five plus the number of times you've cast Aeve from the command zone this game.
353-1812-2034.description:
Cast Aeve from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{G}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Aeve's storm ability triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of itself for each spell you've cast previously this turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing the nontoken Aeve and two Aeve tokens, adding six {C}.
Choose to have Aeve returned to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Prismite three times by paying {6}, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Aeve token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Aeve.
Repeat from step 1.

225-539-573-2248.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Skyshroud Ranger as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

1987-2510-3277.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.You control an artifact or land that enters the battlefield untapped and can produce {U}.
1987-2510-3277.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Izzet Chronarch and your untapped source, blinking them both.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to your hand.
Tap your untapped blue source for {U}.
Repeat.
